title: "Titanic Dashboard"
author: "Hayley Elsbree"
format: dashboard
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- read_csv("https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/titanic_final.csv") |>
  drop_na(Age, Embarked) |>
  mutate(Survived = factor(Survived, labels = c("No", "Yes")),
         Pclass   = factor(Pclass))
```

# Overview

##  {.sidebar}

The Titanic disaster of 1912 resulted in the loss of over 1,500 lives. This dashboard analyzes passenger demographics and survival patterns.

Examining 712 passengers with complete records reveals stark differences in survival rates across different groups.

Data: [titanic_final.csv](https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/titanic_final.csv)

## Column

### Row {height="25%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Passengers"
list(icon = "people", color = "primary", value = nrow(df))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Survivors"
list(icon = "heart-pulse", color = "success",
     value = sum(df$Survived == "Yes"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average Fare"
list(icon = "ticket", color = "info", value = scales::dollar(mean(df$Fare), accuracy = 0.01))

```

### Row {height="75%"}

```{r}
#| title: Age distribution by survival
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Survived, y = Age, fill = Survived)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Survived", y = "Age (years)")
ggplotly(p)
```

```{r}
#| title: Passengers by embarkation port
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Embarked, fill = Survived)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Port of Embarkation", y = "Count", fill = "Survived")
ggplotly(p)
```

# Demographics

## Column {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Fare by Class
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Pclass, y = Fare, fill = Pclass)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Passenger Class", y = "Fare")
ggplotly(p)
```

```{r}
#| title: Age vs Fare
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, y = Fare, color = Survived)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Fare", color = "Survived")
ggplotly(p)
```

# Data

```{r}
library(DT)
#| title: Passenger data (type in the search box to filter)
df |>
  select(Name, Sex, Age, Pclass, Embarked, Fare, Survived) |>
  datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
```
